But of course we can’t trust anything Trump says about the summit or anything else. 

Here he is saying two diametrically opposed things back to back about talks on Taiwan. One a lie and the other the truth - who knows which is which.

Trump also said Xi was a friend because Xi agreed with him that the Iran War was a good thing. 

Of course Xi thinks this! Because it’s weakening the U.S. and tying Iran and China closer together.

Trump seemed to confirm he made a quiet deal to sell more advanced AI chips to China. That’s a disaster that undermines our own high tech economy and gives China an advantage in the race for AI supremacy.

The question is: what happened in Beijing that we didn’t see? What promises did Trump make to Xi on chips or Taiwan? What deals did he make for himself?

It’s clear America got zilch. Even the meager promises Trump claimed weren’t confirmed by Xi (and thus probably aren’t real).
